input.explanation: The quadratic loop is entirely inside average_spend_per_item in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. The patch replaces it with one pass over account.purchases and keeps what the function takes and returns: the average still comes from the purchase list, and an empty history still raises ZeroDivisionError. render_spend_summary calls it the same way it did before. Nothing outside this repository has to change. Once this revision is deployed, the account page stops re-summing the list for every purchase.
